criteria.evidence: Purdue GIS raw snapshot identifies FID 776 as Sigma Pi (SOSP), 130 Russell St; Sigma Pi official location page independently names the Purdue Chapter House at 130 N Russell. Fresh-opened shell bottom vertices compare to 36 unique FID ring vertices; max nearest distance 0.000017 m. The saved current-state orthophoto overlay visually places that exact ring on the roof perimeter.
criteria.uncertainty: GIS Shape__Area=817.3945 m² and Shape__Length=154.0032 m conflict with geodesic calculations from supplied ring (~473.1593 m², ~117.1197 m). Orthophoto supports roof outline; structural wall line behind roof edge is not established.

criteria.evidence: Fresh-opened structural shell bounds in campus coordinates are [[-439.1611328125, -419.6351013183594], [-179.7059326171875, -146.538818359375], [0.25, 9.25]]. It reproduces the project-transformed source vertices with max nearest error 0.000017 m; the overlay registers this plan with current orthophotography.
criteria.uncertainty: This demonstrates source-ring roof-plan registration, not surveyed wall position or dimensions. No independent surveyed coordinate/control points were found.

criteria.criterion: Evidence-backed height, floors, and roof form
criteria.evidence: The saved mesh is about 9.00 m wall height with roof-object top at 9.39 m. Render depicts three occupied-level bands; 2004 chapter newsletter references second-/third-deck work; assessor living-area record is corroborative only.
criteria.uncertainty: Height, floor count, and roof elevation are not measured. GIS NUM_LEVELS=1 and Extrution=12 conflict with multi-deck evidence; newsletter and assessment do not resolve this. Aerial roof image does not establish a reliable roof section. Flat roof is explicitly a placeholder.

criteria.evidence: 2004 chapter newsletter supports broad stucco and wood-trim material cues. The asset contains repeated window/detail objects and a single modest entry; preview shows restrained three-band treatment.
criteria.uncertainty: No inspected current facade photograph, elevation, opening schedule, or plan was available. Window count/rhythm, entrance position, current facade configuration, and distinctive architecture remain estimated.

criteria.criterion: Modular export, portability, and complete evidence

criteria.uncertainty: Coordinator-owned manifest entry still reports the previous one-object massing bounds (Z 0–16 m), inconsistent with this asset's 186-object export and Z 0.25–9.25 m shell. Integration/index reconciliation remains needed.

evidence.manifest_record_status: Stale relative to saved asset: records 1 object and old Z 0-16 m bounds; coordinator owns manifest update.

findings: Identity and roof-plan registration are strongly supported by the official GIS FID, independent address source, raw ring comparison, and current orthophoto overlay.
GIS area/length attributes conflict substantially with supplied ring coordinates; structural wall alignment remains unverified because the imagery traces the roof perimeter.
The modeled 9 m wall height, ~9.39 m roof top, apparent three-level treatment, and flat roof are uncertain; available sources do not give a measured section or roof survey.
Facade details, entrance placement, and opening rhythm are visually modeled without inspected current elevation evidence.
The current asset is portable and has complete source evidence; coordinator-owned manifest bounds and object count are stale and need reconciliation.
